questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Narrative?

options.text: It is the organised sequence of events that a film communicates to its audience.
It is the arrangement of events as actually presented, including what is shown and when.
It is a model dividing a story into setup, confrontation, and resolution.
It is the event that launches the main conflict and sets the plot in motion.

questions.explanation: It is the organised sequence of events that a film communicates to its audience. This is precisely what Narrative means; the alternatives describe Plot, Three-act structure, Inciting incident, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Narrative.

provenance.author: film-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used
